chapter: New Orleans bands, Oliver and Armstrong
title: Solos and the "Kings" in New Orleans
summary: Rose says a solo then was a 16-bar break and bands were known, not leaders. Kings were loud trumpeters who won street band competitions.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline
